original_decision.design_response: Every proposed operation and herald must use reader-accessible records. Verify both rules at every reachable event, including refusals. Resolving unread names can give an upper bound only by a proof that applies to the original unresolved protocol. Check both reader placements and complete surviving target maps.
original_decision.strongest_objection: A protocol could appear to work only because the analyst supplied the unread companion word as a hidden success flag.
